headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 29, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 14.18% compared to SPY's 9.31%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 4.87%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has delivered a remarkable return of 42.20%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100,' has returned only 4.99%. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
